name: Lin Nan
source:
Good at dealing with problems and has fighting spirit. Her math skills are very strong, she has keen hearing, and is able to look at any matter with a calm attitude. She is like a computer in human form.
In July 2205, Lin Nan was commissioned by the international government to conduct research on the “Minions” of the current world, and in December of the same year, she refused the invitation to go to the Ark. Lin Nan signed a final agreement with the United Government that she would stay on Earth on behalf of mankind to search for a way to defeat the Minions and figure out the cause of this destructive catastrophe. In July 2210, Lin Nan travels to Jiangzhong City to hunt down the girl who stole the secret information, and eventually meets up with Jiu Jiu, the protagonist of the story.
